Name: Prize Ticket in Wallet
Author: AbdellatifMohamed
Description:
Have you collected a dozen of prize tickets and put them in a random chest to be forgotten? Do you want to free 1 inventory slot? Do you love doing billboard quests?

Well this mod is for you!

Collected Prize Tickets show up in the Special Powers and Items tab.

Known Bugs:
- Number of collected tickets and icon bug out when using Special Power Utilities mod
- The Prize Tickets can not be used in the Helper's Bundle or any modification to vanilla bundles that has them, it does support bundles added by the framework Unlockable Bundles*

*Any tip to help fix the issue is appreciated

Inspired by Vapius Coins Wallet Currency: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26230 and uses it as a template

Pairs well with:
Prize Machine Round 2: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26394

Also this is my first mod.

Manifest.Name: Prize Tickets in Wallet
Manifest.Description: A tiny mod that turns Prize Tickets to a wallet currency
